content:
Write the equation using exponents:

\[
\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026}x}} = \left(x^{\log_{2026}x}\right)^{1/20}=x^{\frac{\log_{2026}x}{20}}.
\]

So we need

\[
x^{\frac{\log_{2026}x}{20}} = 26x \quad\Rightarrow\quad x^{\frac{\log_{2026}x}{20}-1}=26.
\]

Since \(x>0\) (otherwise the log is undefined), set

\[
u=\log_{2026}x \;\Longrightarrow\; x=2026^u.
\]

Then

\[
x^{u/20} = (2026^u)^{u/20}=2026^{u^2/20}.
\]

The right side is \(26x = 26\cdot 2026^u\). Hence

\[
2026^{u^2/20}=26\cdot 2026^u
\;\Longrightarrow\;
2026^{\frac{u^2}{20}-u}=26
\;\Longrightarrow\;
2026^{\frac{u(u-20)}{20}}=26.
\]

Take \(\log_{2026}\):

\[
\frac{u(u-20)}{20}=\log_{2026}26
\;\Longrightarrow\;
u^2-20u = 20\log_{2026}26.
\]

Thus \(u\) satisfies a quadratic:

\[
u^2-20u - D =0,\qquad D=20\log_{2026}26.
\]

If the roots are \(u_1,u_2\), then by Vieta

\[
u_1+u_2 = 20.
\]

The corresponding \(x\)-values are \(x_i=2026^{u_i}\), so their product is

\[
x_1x_2 = 2026^{u_1+u_2}=2026^{20}.
\]

Check that both roots are real: the discriminant is \(400+4D>0\), so there are exactly two positive solutions.

Now factor \(2026\):

\[
2026 = 2\cdot 1013,\quad 1013 \text{ is prime}.
\]

Hence

\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot 1013^{20}.
\]

The number of positive divisors is

\[
(20+1)(20+1)=21\cdot 21 = 441.
\]

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
